Rules.InvariantScript:
Filter(
    colApprovalsSource,
    (
        IsBlank(varFilterEmployee) ||
        varFilterEmployee in Lower(Coalesce(Employee_Name, "")) ||
        varFilterEmployee in Lower(Coalesce(Employee, ""))
    ) &&
    (
        IsBlank(varFilterFrom) ||
        IsBlank(varFilterTo) ||
        (StartDate <= varFilterTo && EndDate >= varFilterFrom)
    )
)
ThisItem.Type_of_leave & "  ·  " & Text(ThisItem.StartDate, "mmm d") & " - " & Text(ThisItem.EndDate, "mmm d") & "  ·  " & Text(ThisItem.Days) & "d"

If(
    !IsBlank(LookUp(colVacationsUpdates, ID = ThisItem.ID)),
    UpdateIf(
        colVacationsUpdates,
        ID = ThisItem.ID,
        {
            ApprovalStatus_1: Self.Selected.Value,
            Type_of_leave: ThisItem.Type_of_leave,
            TypeofLeave: ThisItem.Type_of_leave,
            Employee: ThisItem.Employee,
            StartDate: ThisItem.StartDate,
            EndDate: ThisItem.EndDate,
            ApproverID_1: ThisItem.ApproverID_1,
            LOG_ID: ThisItem.LOG_ID,
            Approver_Comments: Coalesce(LookUp(colVacationsUpdates, ID = ThisItem.ID).Approver_Comments, ThisItem.Approver_Comments)
        }
    ),
    Collect(
        colVacationsUpdates,
        {
            ID: ThisItem.ID,
            ApprovalStatus_1: Self.Selected.Value,
            ApprovalStatus_2: ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_2,
            Type_of_leave: ThisItem.Type_of_leave,
            TypeofLeave: ThisItem.Type_of_leave,
            Employee: ThisItem.Employee,
            StartDate: ThisItem.StartDate,
            EndDate: ThisItem.EndDate,
            ApproverID_1: ThisItem.ApproverID_1,
            LOG_ID: ThisItem.LOG_ID,
            Approver_Comments: ThisItem.Approver_Comments
        }
    )
)

If(
    !IsBlank(LookUp(colVacationsUpdates, ID = ThisItem.ID)),
    UpdateIf(
        colVacationsUpdates,
        ID = ThisItem.ID,
        { Approver_Comments: Self.Text }
    ),
    Collect(
        colVacationsUpdates,
        {
            ID: ThisItem.ID,
            ApprovalStatus_1: ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1,
            ApprovalStatus_2: ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_2,
            Type_of_leave: ThisItem.Type_of_leave,
            TypeofLeave: ThisItem.Type_of_leave,
            Employee: ThisItem.Employee,
            StartDate: ThisItem.StartDate,
            EndDate: ThisItem.EndDate,
            ApproverID_1: ThisItem.ApproverID_1,
            LOG_ID: ThisItem.LOG_ID,
            Approver_Comments: Self.Text
        }
    )
)
